requirements.requirement: The system must include an 'experience_measure' object in the provider detail API response when provider data is successfully retrieved.
The system must populate 'experience_measure.derived_years_in_practice' using the output from the EVAL-EXP-002 calculation logic.
The system must populate 'experience_measure.normalized_experience_score' in the API response using the computed value from the domain logic.
The system must preserve backward compatibility by not removing or renaming any existing fields in the provider detail API response.
The system must ensure the experience_measure object conforms exactly to the schema defined in EVAL-EXP-001.
The system must integrate the experience measure within provider_detail_service before passing the response to evaluate_care_facade.
The system must ensure evaluate_care_facade includes the experience_measure object in its final serialized API response.
The system must return null or an empty experience_measure object when both enumeration_date and graduation_year are unavailable.
The system must not throw an unhandled exception if experience calculation fails and must still return the provider detail response.
The system must log an error event when experience_measure computation fails during provider detail assembly.
The system must ensure API response latency does not increase by more than 10% due to experience_measure integration under normal conditions.
The system must include experience_measure in all provider detail responses regardless of provider type when NPI data is present.
The system must ensure the experience_measure fields are JSON-serializable and conform to existing API formatting standards.
The system must ensure no duplicate experience_measure fields are introduced in the API response.
The system must ensure LLM-facing tool responses include the experience_measure in a structured, non-ambiguous format.
The system must ensure field names within experience_measure are descriptive and interpretable by downstream LLM components without additional transformation.
The system must ensure normalized_experience_score is bounded within the defined range (e.g., 0–1 or 0–100) for consistent LLM interpretation.
The system must ensure missing subfields within experience_measure are explicitly set to null rather than omitted to avoid LLM misinterpretation.
The system must ensure the experience_measure object is consistently ordered or structured to support deterministic LLM parsing.
The system must ensure that adding experience_measure does not alter or degrade existing tool response schemas consumed by LLM prompts.
